title: 1.5.43 Debug the Order Total
description: Three bugs, none of which produce an error message. Narrow them down with labelled prints. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Write down what it should print
steps.instructions: Before changing anything, work out by hand what the correct total is for 3 notebooks at 4.00 with 10% off and 8% tax. Write it in a comment as your expected outcome.

steps.title: Add labelled prints
steps.instructions: Print each intermediate value with a label: subtotal, discount, taxed, so you can see where the numbers stop matching your expectation.

steps.title: Fix all three bugs
steps.instructions: There are three. One is an operator, one is a quantity that was never used, and one applies a percentage the wrong way round.

steps.title: Prove it with a check
hints: toFixed(2) rounds to two decimal places so the comparison is not thrown off by a long tail
If it says FAIL, one of the three bugs is still there - use your labelled prints to find which

requirements.title: subtotal multiplies price by quantity
requirements.description: The quantity is actually used, with multiplication

requirements.title: The discount is subtracted
requirements.description: The discounted amount is the subtotal minus the discount, not plus

requirements.title: Tax is added to the discounted amount
requirements.description: The final total adds tax rather than subtracting it

requirements.title: At least three labelled prints
requirements.description: Three or more console.log calls whose text includes a label

requirements.title: A PASS/FAIL check is present
requirements.description: An if/else comparing the total against the expected value and printing PASS or FAIL
